messages:
maria: FYI seeing a big spike of 503s for acme-prod around 13:02 PST, customers reporting streaming dropouts :eyes:

jake: yep, alerts show upstream inference worker exited repeatedly. collecting logs now.

maria: attaching excerpt from runner logs:
```
[13:02:11] worker-57: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY during cudaMalloc size=1342177280
[13:02:11] worker-57: fatal signal 11 (SIGSEGV) at pc=0x7f8ab2, thread 0x7f4
[13:02:12] container-manager: restarting container worker-57 (exit=137)
[13:02:12] gateway: 503 from upstream worker-57 for request id=acme-req-4482
```

devon: pattern looks like large toolcall (embed + tool) hitting a memory cliff. customer traffic had a burst of long-embed requests ~120k tokens contexts.

lee: confirm we recently rolled quantized weights for this model in hosted pool last night? could be memory delta.

jake: correct, v2-quant rolled at 02:10. rollout to pool-a only. metrics show p95 mem usage jumped after rollout.

sre_bot: DeployBot: Container worker-57 restarted 4 times in the last 5m. Autoscaler not evicting due to reserved capacity.

maria: customer impact: acme reported ~45% of requests failing with 503 and streaming truncated. Support pinged on call.

support_bot: SupportPager: Escalation created (#INC-8742) and customer notified. CS lead on standby.

devon: quick mitigation suggestions: 1) pin pool to previous model variant (v2-fp16) 2) rate-limit large-context toolcalls for acme tenant 3) enable fallback to CPU-smaller model for streaming requests

jake: starting rollback to v2-fp16 on pool-a now. will redirect new sessions to fallback pool.

maria: repro steps we used:
1) curl -X POST /v1/chat:generate -d '{"model":"v2-quant","input":"<~120k tokens>","toolcall":true}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...'
2) observe worker mem climb then SIGSEGV within ~8-12s

lee: added heap dump capture for the next crash and increased cgroup limit temporarily so container doesn't die immediately (lets us capture stack).

jake: rollback in progress — routing updated, old variant pinned for acme tenant. rolling restart of affected hosts starting.

sre_bot: Monitoring: error rate on acme-prod dropped from 42% -> 8% after routing change (10m window).

support_bot: CS update sent to acme: "We identified upstream worker crashes tied to a model rollout and have temporarily pinned you to the prior variant while we investigate. We're collecting logs and will follow up with root cause."

devon: next steps for postmortem: - full comparison of memory footprint v2-quant vs v2-fp16 - reproduce on staging with identical batchsize and long-context toolcall - run valgrind/asan style checks on kernel paths if we can repro segfault - consider reducing allocated cache size for quant path

maria: owner for RCA: devon + jake. CS followup: lee. set priority P1 until fixes merged.

lee: FYI added temporary throttling rule: limit concurrent toolcall streams >60k tokens to 2 concurrent per tenant.

jake: ticket INC-8742 updated with rollback timestamp and heap dumps location: s3://redwood-incident-dumps/1791239999/

maria: thanks everyone. keep updates short here. if it spikes again @devon please escalate to infra oncall. :thumbsup:
